known_facts_book1: The Water of Oblivion bubbles in a golden basin in the Emerald City palace grounds, marked by a sign forbidding anyone to drink.
Whoever drinks at it instantly forgets everything he has ever known, becoming as innocent as a baby.
Was placed there long ago by Glinda to make a wicked King and his people forget their wickedness.
The invaders drink from it and forget their enmity; the Scarecrow's plan uses it to save Oz.
The Nome King is thrown into its basin and drinks, forgetting everything.
